name: ladybird
readme_excerpt: Ladybird Ladybird is a truly independent web browser, using a novel engine based on web standards. > [!IMPORTANT] > Ladybird is in a pre-alpha state, and only suitable for use by developers Features We aim to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. Ladybird uses a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process.
